description: Test suite for reaction-related functionalities in Mattermost, including saving and deleting reactions, handling restricted DMs, and shared channel synchronization.

methods.name: TestSaveReactionForPost
methods.description: Tests saving reactions to posts, including success, failure due to non-existent emoji, limit restrictions, and restricted DM scenarios.

methods.name: TestDeleteReactionForPostWithRestrictedDM
methods.description: Tests deletion of reactions in restricted direct message channels.

methods.name: TestSharedChannelSyncForReactionActions
methods.description: Tests content synchronization when adding or removing reactions in shared channels.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Helper method to update the configuration within tests, respecting read-only state.
